description: SHC runtime routines the compiler calls by name, at their retail addresses. Each address is proven by a verified unit whose pool holds it: tu0_10 and tu2_01 for __quick_odd_mvn, tu5_04 and tu5_05 for __slow_mvn and __modls. __modlu was identified by an agent from the compiler's own import name and retail's call target; no verified unit proves it yet. Two agents saw SHC name a 12-byte copy __quick_mvn at retail's 0x0c1fb7a0 call site, so both quick names map there; unproven by a verified unit.
